# Verified protocols

To support a variety of use cases, Vault verifies protocol implementation and
integrations with partner products, appliances, and applications that support
advanced data protection features.

## IPv6 validation and compliance ((#ipv6))

[Vault Enterprise supports IPv6](https://www.hashicorp.com/trust/compliance/vault-enterprise)
in compliance with OMB Mandate M-21-07 and Federal IPv6 policy requirements
for the following operating systems and storage backends.

**Self-attested testing covers functionality related to HSM, FIPS 140-3, and
HSM/FIPS 140-3.**

## OS validation

We test all Tier 1 artifacts, including in IPv6 mode. Tier 2 artifacts have
best-effort support.

- **Tier 1**: All Linux artifacts for Vault server and Vault Client, and all
  Vault Client artifacts.
- **Tier 2**: Vault server artifacts for operating systems other than Linux.

Operating system | Architecture | Vault server  | Vault Client  | Tier 1 test environment
---------------- | ------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -----------------------
Linux            | 386          | Tier 1        | Not available | CI runners
Linux            | amd64        | Tier 1        | Tier 1        | [Linux distributions](#linux-distributions)
Linux            | arm64        | Tier 1        | Tier 1        | [Linux distributions](#linux-distributions)
Linux            | ppc64le      | Tier 1        | Tier 1        | [Linux distributions](#linux-distributions)
Linux            | s390x        | Tier 1        | Tier 1        | [Linux distributions](#linux-distributions)
AIX              | ppc64        | Not available | Tier 1        | IBM lab (POWER8)
Windows          | 386          | Tier 2        | Tier 1        | CI runners
Windows          | amd64        | Tier 2        | Tier 1        | CI runners
macOS            | amd64        | Tier 2        | Not available | N/A
macOS            | arm64        | Tier 2        | Not available | N/A
FreeBSD          | 386          | Tier 2        | Not available | N/A
FreeBSD          | amd64        | Tier 2        | Not available | N/A

We also test Tier 1 Vault server and Vault Client container images on
Kubernetes.

<Note title="IPv6 limitations for Windows">

  IPv6 does not work with external plugins (plugins not built into Vault) when
  running on Windows in server mode because they default to IPv4 and Vault
  cannot override that behavior.

</Note>

### Linux distributions ((#linux-distributions))

We test Tier 1 Linux artifacts on the following distributions:

Distribution | Versions
------------ | -------------------
Amazon Linux | 2023
RHEL         | 8.10, 9.7, 10.1
SUSE SLES    | 15.7, 16.0
Ubuntu       | 22.04, 24.04, 26.04

### Editions by Linux architecture ((#linux-editions))

The following table lists the Vault editions available for each Linux
architecture. Vault server artifacts for other operating systems use the `ent`
edition.

Edition                         | 386       | amd64     | arm64     | ppc64le   | s390x
------------------------------- | :-------: | :-------: | :-------: | :-------: | :-------:
`ent`                           | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#9989;
`ent.hsm`                       | &#10060;  | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#10060;  | &#9989;
`ent.fips1403`                  | &#10060;  | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#10060;  | &#10060;
`ent.hsm.fips1403`              | &#10060;  | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#10060;  | &#10060;
`ent.client` (Vault Client)     | &#10060;  | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#9989;   | &#9989;
